title: MLST投稿前作者清单与最小确认方案

selected_documents.path_note: Paths describe the intended repository layout of this MLST handoff; identity must be confirmed against the newly archived CHECKPOINT.json and MANIFEST.json. Creating this checklist is not a claim that a new remote commit or DOI has already been published.

main_point: 当前有限域回顾性稿已完成本轮定向重组；作者与数据访问安排仍需闭合。独立同域、校准和表示扩展可加强证据，但不能靠编辑或重用旧目标补造。没有可校准的录用概率估计。
policy_summary: MLST明确适用IOP open-data policy：发表时需公开验证或复现结论所需支持数据。只写upon request不满足；确有合法限制须说明理由、来源和获取路径并由编辑审查例外。提交时提供可用标识或预登记信息与审稿访问。可信仓库/DOI及开放重用许可受到鼓励，不能把推荐误说成已完成或自动代选许可。

gates_for_bounded_manuscript.title: 由真实作者确认本文只主张已有证据支持的内容
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.action: 逐读最终主文、补充材料和引用；同意将25P称回顾性开发、46外部曲线称来源已查看的无重训练迁移压力测试。保留插值输给对照、局部欠覆盖、三源失利与族权重反转。不得签署未实际完成的复核。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.done_when: 真实作者确认解释、图表、引用及贡献边界，能对模型和结果承担责任。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.basis: Local scientific readiness; IOP author/AI responsibilities

gates_for_bounded_manuscript.title: 落实支撑结论所需数据的可验证访问安排
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.action: 按下方清单区分已公开的分数复算/冻结推断与尚缺的原始处理输入、原训练/外折重放。对每项决定公开或由合法上游稳定访问并精确重建；确有法律或伦理障碍时，写明限制、第三方来源和实际获取途径，由编辑审查例外。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.done_when: 提交时有可用链接、持久标识或预登记标识及必要的审稿访问安排；发表时所需支持数据公开，或已取得期刊对具体例外的认可。仅写upon request不够。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.basis: MLST is explicitly covered by the IOP open-data policy, not merely the generic availability policy

gates_for_bounded_manuscript.title: 确认原始资产与第三方条款，作者选择许可
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.action: 分别确定自有程序、权重、稿件和处理数据的权利人与重用条款；不代选MIT或CC许可，不把上游CC条款自动套给所有衍生资产。granular数据的other-open标签不是已核定的再分发授权。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.done_when: 清楚列出哪些资产可发布、允许何种重用，第三方必须保留的署名/限制，以及不能镜像资产的合法源获取路径；正文、仓库和DAS一致。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.basis: Author-controlled rights decision; no particular external-repository data license mandated by IOP

gates_for_bounded_manuscript.title: 补齐署名、单位、基金、冲突与提交信息
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.action: 填写并核对作者姓名、单位、邮箱、通讯作者、贡献、基金编号和利益冲突；提交者提供ORCID。由作者确认作者同意、原创/既往投稿情况和期刊伦理声明，不能沿用占位符或由工具代签。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.done_when: 所有姓名与声明由实际作者确认，投稿系统字段与主文一致。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.basis: Official submission workflow plus author responsibility

gates_for_bounded_manuscript.title: 核实实际AI工具配置及人工验证范围
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.action: 本项目AI参与选题/资料检索、程序、分析核查和写作，超出拼写检查。核真实工具/模型版本、使用日期和用途，并由作者说明实际验证及批判性审阅；在Acknowledgements独立披露，研究过程用途也在Methods说明。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.done_when: 版本未知就明确待核，不编造模型号；每篇引用核原始来源；不把生成曲线当测量，不将AI列为作者，不用套话宣称未进行的全面人工验证。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.basis: IOP generative-AI policy; actual assistance in this project

gates_for_bounded_manuscript.title: 核最终版本、文件和数据声明
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.action: 按最终CHECKPOINT/MANIFEST核主文、SI、图表及一键复算入口；提交可读的完整PDF，按实际系统要求附SI/权限说明。确认摘要、字数与文件大小符合当前作者指南。替换稿中的作者及数据访问待办文字后，重新检查引用与分页。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.done_when: 主文、SI、cover letter和DAS指向同一版本；没有未填作者字段、无效链接或把大本地归档包当成期刊SI。
gates_for_bounded_manuscript.basis: Official submission guidance and local version control

asset_inventory.state: 已有公开检查点；本轮科学字节保持
asset_inventory.can_do: 从六个合规锚点生成同一联合法则；读取模型卡与单位/支持限制。
asset_inventory.cannot_claim: 全数据deployment权重不是25个外折模型，不能对训练P回测并冒称论文留一结果。
asset_inventory.author_action: 确认权重及程序许可、发布版本与源绑定。

asset_inventory.asset: 既有开发分数与表格复算
asset_inventory.state: 已公开scalar证据，不是完整训练重放
asset_inventory.can_do: 从保存的675/375/75行分数重建相应表格。
asset_inventory.cannot_claim: 不读取原测量标签、不重拟合、不重新预测；不能独立重造原始评分。
asset_inventory.author_action: 允许审稿人用公开算术入口核对表格，同时补充下项所需输入访问。

asset_inventory.asset: 完整原处理输入、原训练与外折资源
asset_inventory.state: 现有公开snapshot未全含；作者需落实
asset_inventory.can_do: 现有来源/分组与已保存分数具追溯入口。
asset_inventory.cannot_claim: 本地存在大ZIP或公开了源DOI，不等于处理缓存、全部外折预测法则和参考拟合已可供重放。
asset_inventory.author_action: 选择可公开的最小充分材料：合法原生P响应和S所用锚点或精确源重建、单位/角色/分组、固定折与预处理、模型/对照设置、必要运行代码和外折预测/评分资产。可提供完整确定性重建路径而非机械镜像所有原件。隐藏S结果未用于本文，不应为凑公开资料而解除其访问边界。

asset_inventory.asset: 外部四源来源、单元格映射与重建
asset_inventory.state: 映射/reader公开，上游原件按条款获取
asset_inventory.can_do: 按来源哈希和精确单元格规则重建既有46曲线/1057对的输入；需原文件及读取依赖。
asset_inventory.cannot_claim: 元数据开放不自动授权第三方原数组镜像；重新运行不是新独立确认。
asset_inventory.author_action: 逐项保留上游条款、版本、来源和归属；不能镜像时如实说明原源路径及访问障碍。

asset_inventory.asset: 外部分数、权重和本轮UQ再组织
asset_inventory.state: 既有结果公开；MLST入口为本轮新归档内容
asset_inventory.can_do: 一条标准库命令复算保存分数及MLST表号映射，核Liverpool区间质量/零覆盖计数。
asset_inventory.cannot_claim: 不拟合、不重新评分、无新校准或同域独立数据，也不重新渲染所有图。
asset_inventory.author_action: 以本轮最终归档清单确认新入口确已发布；不要用仅有本机的链接代替审稿入口。

asset_inventory.asset: 数值实现检查与合成示例
asset_inventory.can_do: 复核接口、数学实现及合成训练原语。
asset_inventory.cannot_claim: 合成演示不是材料测量，不补独立批次、概率校准或实验节约。
asset_inventory.author_action: 保留synthetic标识，区分验证代码与验证材料效果。

optional_stronger_evidence.evidence: 真正未消费的同域确认
optional_stronger_evidence.reason: 最直接区分原目标墨水域的可复现收益与跨化学/状态混杂的压力测试。
optional_stronger_evidence.needs: 有来源/配方/制备批次身份的新曲线、原生坐标、单位、温度/测量状态及未揭示目标；新配方、新批次和新实验室分别分组。
optional_stronger_evidence.plan: 先固定方法/锚点/终点/失败处理/数据排除及分组，再冻结预测、揭示目标。
optional_stronger_evidence.current_status: 未执行，数据及数量未登记。

optional_stronger_evidence.evidence: 独立材料单位的校准与独立确认
optional_stronger_evidence.reason: 当前局部/外部欠覆盖尚未修复；误差条不自动可信。
optional_stronger_evidence.needs: 未用于模型/窗口/阈值选择的校准单位，另留确认单位；明确有限网格整曲线还是单点边际覆盖。
optional_stronger_evidence.plan: 可评估固定尺度或curve-level split conformal；不得把老25P、46外部已消费曲线、坐标点或生成样本当新校准材料。
optional_stronger_evidence.current_status: 未执行；下附的是数学设计，不是已完成算法或结果。

optional_stronger_evidence.evidence: 表示稳健性与容量受控的功能基线
optional_stronger_evidence.reason: 现有数据仅支持相对一个固定随机表示的结论。
optional_stronger_evidence.needs: 预固定随机方向集合、FPCA或另一种局部基；如加入CNP需单独确定架构/预算/种子和训练单位。
optional_stronger_evidence.plan: 新拟合在清楚的开发协议内完成，折内预处理与内层选择；不替换原结果，不拿消费过的外部源调参后再叫验证。
optional_stronger_evidence.current_status: 未执行，不虚构FPCA/CNP效果；50–100个随机种子不是官方要求。

optional_stronger_evidence.evidence: 适用域或拒绝/回退策略
optional_stronger_evidence.reason: 现有来源异质性提示风险，但没有验证过的安全阈值。
optional_stronger_evidence.needs: 合法锚点/参考信息构造事先定义的risk指标，独立保留单位验证选择性覆盖与误差。
optional_stronger_evidence.plan: 公开全阈值描述与独立阈值评估，不能按当前外部得分挑获胜阈值。
optional_stronger_evidence.current_status: 未执行；公开scalar导出不含逐曲线h，不能假装已有风险曲线。

optional_stronger_evidence.evidence: 锚点效率、其他响应任务与真实实验资源
optional_stronger_evidence.reason: 可增强应用意义，但属于额外证据，而非本有限稿统一必需。
optional_stronger_evidence.needs: 不同锚点数需新的预测协议；真实成本需仪器/制备/平衡/清洗/失败等记录，第二任务须有真实数据。
optional_stronger_evidence.plan: 回顾性掩码仅称测量效率模拟；实测节约另做质量可比的资源对照。
optional_stronger_evidence.current_status: 未执行；6/39不是实验成本节约比例。

not_official_thresholds: 12–20条曲线不是MLST官方要求或功效保证。
50–100个随机表示不是官方门槛，也不代表已做。
8500词是已核官方通常篇幅口径，不据此编造摘要/参考/公式的排除计数规则。
任何35–65%录用概率区间均未由可校准证据支持，本清单不沿用。

future_confirmation_template.question: Does the frozen curvature model improve one-sided continuation on genuinely unused compatible precursor-ink units, and does an independently fitted calibration layer achieve its declared coverage target?

frozen_reference_model.candidate: fixed two-contrast shared Gaussian correction with full reference residual
frozen_reference_model.changes_allowed_before_confirmation: None unless a separately versioned new candidate and protocol are created.

future_confirmation_template.data_role_rule: Reserve real calibration and confirmation units before inspecting their target responses; do not split masks or related runs from one physical unit across roles. No consumed25P/46external targets are newly independent.
future_confirmation_template.target_rule: Only native declared positions strictly above the highest observed anchor and within frozen global support; no interpolation or generated targets as measured truth.

primary_endpoint.suggestion: Per-unit CRPS on log viscosity averaged over continuation targets with normalized trapezoidal log-rate weights, then aggregated by the declared independent unit.
primary_endpoint.historical_endpoint_note: This is a possible new endpoint; it does not replace the original native-position three-layout endpoint.

secondary_endpoints: log RMSE or pooled MSE with stated weights
marginal coverage at the fixed nominal level
all prediction failures, including zero-coverage units
freeze_and_reveal: 1. Author signs material/unit/metadata/admission plan and complete fields, then records actualUTC and input/runtime hashes.
2. Fit no correction on confirmation outcomes; freeze any calibrator using only its reserved units and record its new version.
3. Read only six allowed anchors per confirmation unit and freeze all candidate/control predictions with source hashes.
4. A steward reveals complete original targets once; score all eligible units with registered weights and explicit failures.
5. Report the full cohort and all controls, whether successful or not; no posthoc reclassification as independent after revision.

calibration_extension.method: curve-level split conformal band around frozen log-Gaussian predictor
calibration_extension.formula: s_i=max_{j in H_i}|y_ij-mu_ij|/sigma_ij; k=ceil((n_cal+1)(1-alpha)); q=s_(k) if k<=n_cal, otherwise +infinity; B_j=[mu_j-q*sigma_j,mu_j+q*sigma_j].
calibration_extension.score_scale: dimensionless natural-log viscosity; sigma_ij must be positive under a fixed pre-calibration rule
calibration_extension.exchangeability: Conditional on model training and frozen score/design, reserved calibration units and the future unit must be exchangeable as complete units. Related coordinates or runs are not separate units. If the scientific target is a new batch, use a defensible batch-level score/design.
calibration_extension.guarantee_if_assumptions_hold: Marginal probability over the calibration sample and a new compatible unit of all declared finite-grid targets lying in their bands is at least1-alpha. Not conditional per chemistry/subgroup and not coverage between grid points.
calibration_extension.small_sample_rule: If k>n_cal, use an infinite band rather than silently lowering the order-statistic index. No usable finite-band or power guarantee is implied by a proposed sample count.
calibration_extension.density_warning: Conformal bands are prediction sets, not a calibrated joint density or generative law. Do not assign them a newly inventedCRPS/joint log density; keep the original Gaussian law distinct.
calibration_extension.unit_log_to_viscosity: Multiply exp(band endpoints) by eta_ref=1Pa s.
calibration_extension.proof_note: A scalar maximum score makes finite-grid simultaneous inclusion equivalent to s_new<=q. Exchangeability supplies the rank bound; no independence of coordinates within a curve is assumed.

future_confirmation_template.prohibition: Do not fill sample sizes, tolerance, batch identities or registration times from old scores or invented values. This template is not an executed or preregistered study.

source_ledger.read_depth: Official130-line page, including explicitMLST applicability, required supporting-data access, third-party exceptions, data-availability statement, licensing and submission identifiers; read directly in this handoff subtask.
source_ledger.not_claimed: No automatic approval of an exception or mandatory selection of a particular software/data license.

source_ledger.read_depth: Official material-use/disclosure/author responsibility sections read directly.
source_ledger.used_for: Accurate tool-role disclosure and author review.
source_ledger.not_claimed: Historical model/version configuration or completed human validation not independently supplied.

source_ledger.read_depth: Official author information,ORCID,funder,cover-letter and initialPDF upload sections read directly.
source_ledger.not_claimed: No journal submission or author account action.

source_ledger.read_depth: Uses this run’s separate official-policy audit for normal8500-word recommendation andSI/file guidance; no newly invented word-exclusion convention.
source_ledger.not_claimed: No acceptance prediction or authenticatedCAS partition certificate.

source_ledger.read_depth: Selected Section2 rank quantile, Section2.2 split conformal/Theorem2.2 and Section5.2 heading/context; not entire50-page paper.
source_ledger.used_for: Standard exchangeable-rank design; curve-level maximum-score specialization is a proposed mathematical adaptation, not new empirical work.
source_ledger.not_claimed: No independent calibration executed, no theorem claiming validity under arbitrary material/source shift.

verified_reviewer_commands.role: Saved-score arithmetic only; Python3.10+ standard library, new output directory.
Frozen inference on explicitly synthetic anchors; dependencies required. This command is documented, not newly executed here.

no_actions_taken: No repository orDOCX edits by this checklist subtask.
No data upload, author contact, journal submission orDOI publication.
No material fitting, forecasting, rescoring, calibration or new measurement.
